essence: One who eats while standing in water during an eclipse becomes a lord of speech.
One should mutter the mantra while mounted on a corpse with a mind devoted to the highest end of knowledge.
Through this practice one becomes master of all knowledges and obtains all accomplishment.
Sitting and placing the hands on the heads of the two, one should mutter the mantra.
One who is curious will certainly behold the wonder of this knowledge.
